title: Ascendant
short_description: Ascendant — a first-person parkour gauntlet across five worlds. Precision jumps, collapsing platforms, sweeping blades and rising lava, with checkpoints that make every death a lesson instead of a punishment.
description:
ASCENDANT is a first-person obstacle course built for people who like the moment a jump lands by two centimetres.

You start in the Sanctum, a quiet hub ringed by five portals, and you climb. NEON DOJO teaches you the language — precision beams, moving platforms, panels that blink out from under your boots. LAVA FOUNDRY takes it underground, where crushers slam on a beat, conveyor belts fight your footing and the lava keeps rising. FROZEN SPIRE takes away your friction. SKY TEMPLE takes away the ground. And PRISM CROWN — the light after the storm — asks for every lesson, in every colour, one last time.

The movement is the game: momentum-preserving acceleration, coyote time, jump buffering, variable jump height, real air control that lets you save a bad launch, and wall-slides you can push off. Nothing floats. Nothing sticks. Every hazard runs on a deterministic clock, so the gauntlet that killed you presents exactly the same timing on the next attempt — you learn it, you beat it.

Checkpoints are frequent and fair, the respawn is under a second, and the timer keeps running. Beat your best. Collect the orbs on the risky line. Clear a world.
controls_keyboard: WASD move · Mouse look · SPACE jump (hold for height) · SHIFT sprint · CTRL crouch · R restart stage · T back to checkpoint · TAB stage select · ESC pause
art_direction: Cinematic single-moment key art. Low dramatic angle from just behind and below a leaping runner so the figure reads large against the sky; one clear focal figure mid-air, arms outstretched, motion streak on the trailing foot. Glowing cyan platform edges and hot ember-orange hazard light raking across wet dark stone. Deep atmospheric haze separating a foreground platform edge, midground floating islands and a distant spire. Painterly digital illustration, saturated teal-and-ember palette, strong rim lighting, sparks and drifting ice particles, volumetric god rays. NEVER a labelled world-select collage and never baked-in text.
